affine_six_bit_test.hypothesis: F2^6 acts regularly and the sheet is one linear coordinate extending the certified sheet action
affine_six_bit_test.reason: the certified regular 32-state sheet group is nonabelian extraspecial and contains order-4 elements, whereas F2^5 is elementary abelian

claim_boundary: Exact finite-group obstruction conditional only on the external two-component census and the repo's certified regular extraspecial sheet action. It does not rule out arbitrary six-bit labels unrelated to that action, nor does it identify the full 2_+^{1+6} action on individual Schur lines.

external_input.source: P. Nurowski, arXiv:2609.10751 (2026), Proposition 3.1; Naskrecki-Pokora arXiv:2607.07898

information_reading.qualification: one bit only as a set-level sheet choice under a uniform prior; not an ontic-randomness claim and not a sixth linear Pauli coordinate

sheet_torsor.second_sheet: transported by the projective automorphism exchanging D and D*

theorem: The 64 ordinary Schur triple points are naturally two 32-state extraspecial torsors exchanged by symmetry. The sheet label contributes one set-level bit, but it cannot be the missing sixth linear coordinate of an affine F2^6 translation extension compatible with the certified 2_+^{1+4} regular sheet action.
